formula: It + be + for + person + to + base verb It is for you to decide

formulas.formula: It + be + for + person + to + base verb It is for you to decide

example: It is for you to decide.

examples.en: It is for you to decide.
examples.highlight: It is for you to decide.

rules.zh: 核心句型可以在動詞後結束，句子仍然完整。應由你作出決定。 不應由我評斷。 或 say 後面的資料是可選的延伸部分，不是固定句型的一部分。應由你決定是否接受這項提議。 應由小組判定事故由甚麼引起。 誰需要負責，不應由我判定。
rules.en: The core structure is complete by itself The basic expression may end after the verb. It is for you to decide. It is not for me to judge. The information after decide, determine or say is an optional extension. decide, determine It is for you to decide whether to accept the offer. It is for the panel to determine what caused the accident. It is not for me to say who is responsible. The core expressions remain: It is for the panel to determine. It is not for me to say.

rules.zh: 介詞 for 後面要用受格代名詞，例如 me、you、him、her、us 或 them；不可使用主格代名詞。
rules.en: Use object pronouns after “for” Use: for me for you for him for her for us for them It is for her to decide. It is for she to decide.

rules.zh: 詞語【Decide】用於作出選擇或決定。應由家人決定是否搬遷。 詞語【Determine】常用於正式、仔細或根據證據作出的判定。應由法院判定是否有人違法。 詞語【Say】用於表示某人是適合或有權作出意見或判斷的人。應由醫生判斷治療是否奏效。
rules.en: “Decide”, “determine” and “say” have different uses Decide Use decide for making a choice or reaching a decision. It is for the family to decide whether to move. Determine Use determine for reaching an official, careful or evidence-based judgement. It is for the court to determine whether the law was broken. Say Use say when someone is the appropriate person to give an opinion or judgement. It is for the doctor to say whether the treatment is working.

rules.zh: 核心句型不只限於使用 It is。應由委員會作出決定。 當時應由委員會作出決定。 將由委員會作出決定。 時態必須配合原句意思。
rules.en: The tense of “be” may change The basic structure is not limited to It is. Present: It is for the committee to decide. Past: It was for the committee to decide. Future: It will be for the committee to decide. The tense should match the original meaning.

rules.zh: 目標句型可以放在引導分句之後。雖然專家可以提供意見，但應由委員會作出決定。 它也可以放在轉述句之中。職員明白，應由總監作出決定。 這些開首分句或轉述句只是可選的句子延伸，並不是固定核心句型的一部分。
rules.en: The structure does not always need to appear first The target structure may follow an introductory clause. Although experts may give advice, it is for the committee to decide. It may also appear inside a reported statement. The staff understood that it was for the director to decide. These opening or reporting clauses are optional sentence extensions. They are not part of the fixed core expression.

rules.zh: 應由法官而不是報章判定證據是否充分。 用來加入對比；即使刪去，核心句子仍然完整。應由法官判定證據是否充分。
rules.en: A contrast may be inserted after the person It is for + person A, not person B, to + verb It is for the judge, not the newspaper, to determine whether the evidence is sufficient. The phrase not person B adds a contrast. The sentence remains complete without it. not person B It is for the judge to determine whether the evidence is sufficient.

rules.zh: 應由父母決定孩子入讀哪間學校，而應由學生決定修讀哪些選修科目。 在第二部分中，讀者已能理解省略了 it is，因此不必重複寫出。
rules.en: Two responsible parties may be contrasted It is for the parents to decide which school the child attends, but for the student to decide which optional subjects to take. In the second part, it is is understood and does not need to be repeated.

rules.zh: 學生定期溫習十分重要。 這裏的 for students to revise regularly 說明誰應進行這項重要的行動。它並不表示學生擁有作出決定的權力。應由學生作出決定。 老師不應代他們作出決定。
rules.en: Do not confuse this structure with an adjective pattern The following sentence has a different structure: It is important for students to revise regularly. Here, for students to revise regularly explains who should perform an important action. It does not mean that students have the authority to make a decision. This lesson focuses on: It is for the students to decide. It is not for the teacher to decide for them.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚指出最後應由誰作出決定或判斷。顧問可以提出建議，但應由部長作出決定。 這句清楚區分了「提供意見」和「承擔最終決定責任」。
benefits.en: It clearly shows who has the final responsibility This structure tells the listener exactly who should make the decision or judgement. The advisers may offer suggestions, but it is for the minister to decide. The sentence makes the difference between giving advice and having final responsibility clear.

benefits.zh: 你不必直接指責某人干涉，也可以較有禮貌地表示該事情並不屬於對方的職責或權力範圍。你不應告訴他們如何使用金錢。 我們不應告訴他們如何使用金錢。 第二句把重點放在我們的身分和權力界線，而不是直接批評對方。
benefits.en: It helps you set a polite boundary Instead of directly accusing someone of interfering, you can explain that the matter is outside that person’s role. Direct: You should not tell them how to spend their money. More controlled: It is not for us to tell them how to spend their money. The second version focuses on the limit of our role rather than attacking the other person.

benefits.zh: 當決定必須由適當的人或機構作出時，這個句型尤其實用。應由法院判定證據是否充分。 某人是否有罪，不應由傳媒判定。
benefits.en: It is useful when discussing fair decisions The structure is especially useful when decisions must be made by the correct person or organisation. It is for the court to determine whether the evidence is sufficient. It is not for the media to determine whether someone is guilty.

benefits.zh: 很多人都可以提出意見，但最終責任可能只屬於某一個人或組織。雖然醫療團隊可以解釋各個選項，但應由病人作出決定。 這能讓讀者更容易理解不同人物所負責的角色。
benefits.en: It separates advice from authority Many people may give opinions, but only one person or group may have the final responsibility. Although the medical team can explain the options, it is for the patient to decide. This makes the roles of the different people easier to understand.

benefits.zh: 討論責任、個人選擇、專業權力或道德判斷時，你可以直接使用這個現成句型。這些句型框架能幫助你在說話時更快組織答案。
benefits.en: It gives you a ready-made speaking frame You can use this structure when discussing responsibility, personal choice, professional authority or moral judgement. It is for ___ to decide. It is for ___ to determine whether ___. It is not for me to say ___. It is not for us to judge ___. These frames make it easier to organise an answer while speaking.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以直接使用，也可以放在引導分句之後或較長的轉述句中。應由董事會作出決定。 考慮證據後，應由董事會作出決定。 報告指出，當時應由董事會作出決定。 這能避免每句都使用完全相同的開首和排列方式。
benefits.en: It allows more varied sentence organisation The structure can appear directly, after an introductory clause or inside a longer reported statement. Direct: It is for the board to decide. After an introductory clause: After considering the evidence, it is for the board to decide. Inside a reported statement: The report stated that it was for the board to decide. This helps prevent every sentence from having exactly the same opening and structure.
